body.content:
{%- liquid assign matching_set_heading = 'products.product.matching_set.heading' | t assign matching_set_copy = 'products.product.matching_set.copy' | t assign matching_set_empty = 'products.product.matching_set.empty' | t assign matching_set_add = 'products.product.matching_set.add' | t assign matching_set_success = 'products.product.matching_set.success' | t assign matching_set_error = 'products.product.matching_set.error' | t assign grouped_size_guide_label = 'products.product.size_guide.compare_family_sizes' | t assign compare_size_guide_label = 'products.product.size_guide.compare_all_sizes' | t assign single_size_guide_label = 'products.product.size_guide.guide_and_fit' | t assign selected_size_guide_label = 'products.product.size_guide.your_size_details' | t assign size_guide_compare_hint = 'products.product.size_guide.compare_hint' | t assign size_guide_unit_toggle_label = 'products.product.size_guide.chart_units' | t assign current_locale_root = request.locale.iso_code | default: localization.language.iso_code | default: '' | split: '-' | first | downcase assign reviews_heading = 'products.product.reviews.heading' | t assign photo_heading = 'products.product.reviews.photo_heading' | t assign customer_photos_heading = 'Customer photos' case current_locale_root when 'cs' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Fotky zákazníků' when 'da' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Kundebilleder' when 'de' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Kundenfotos' when 'el' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Φωτογραφίες πελατών' when 'es' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Fotos de clientes' when 'fr' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Photos clients' when 'it' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Foto dei clienti' when 'nl' assign customer_photos_heading = "Foto's van klanten" when 'pl' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Zdjęcia klientów' when 'pt' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Fotos de clientes' when 'ro' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Fotografii de la clienți' when 'sv' assign customer_photos_heading = 'Kundfoton' endcase assign jump_to_reviews = 'products.product.reviews.jump_to_reviews' | t assign pdu_rating_count_raw = product.metafields.reviews.rating_count.value | default: product.metafields.reviews.rating_count assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_rating_count_raw | plus: 0 if pdu_rating_count <= 0 assign pdu_judgeme_badge_metafield = product.metafields.judgeme.badge assign pdu_judgeme_badge_markup = pdu_judgeme_badge_metafield.value | default: pdu_judgeme_badge_metafield | default: '' | append: '' | strip_newlines if pdu_judgeme_badge_markup != blank if pdu_judgeme_badge_markup contains 'data-number-of-reviews="' assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_judgeme_badge_markup | split: 'data-number-of-reviews="' | last | split: '"' | first | replace: ',', '' | plus: 0 elsif pdu_judgeme_badge_markup contains "data-number-of-reviews='" assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_judgeme_badge_markup | split: "data-number-of-reviews='" | last | split: "'" | first | replace: ',', '' | plus: 0 elsif pdu_judgeme_badge_markup contains 'data-reviews-count="' assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_judgeme_badge_markup | split: 'data-reviews-count="' | last | split: '"' | first | replace: ',', '' | plus: 0 elsif pdu_judgeme_badge_markup contains "data-reviews-count='" assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_judgeme_badge_markup | split: "data-reviews-count='" | last | split: "'" | first | replace: ',', '' | plus: 0 endif endif endif if pdu_rating_count <= 0 assign pdu_judgeme_widget_metafield = product.metafields.judgeme.widget assign pdu_judgeme_widget_markup = pdu_judgeme_widget_metafield.value | default: pdu_judgeme_widget_metafield | default: '' | append: '' | strip_newlines if pdu_judgeme_widget_markup != blank if pdu_judgeme_widget_markup contains 'data-number-of-reviews="' assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_judgeme_widget_markup | split: 'data-number-of-reviews="' | last | split: '"' | first | replace: ',', '' | plus: 0 elsif pdu_judgeme_widget_markup contains "data-number-of-reviews='" assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_judgeme_widget_markup | split: "data-number-of-reviews='" | last | split: "'" | first | replace: ',', '' | plus: 0 elsif pdu_judgeme_widget_markup contains 'data-reviews-count="' assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_judgeme_widget_markup | split: 'data-reviews-count="' | last | split: '"' | first | replace: ',', '' | plus: 0 elsif pdu_judgeme_widget_markup contains "data-reviews-count='" assign pdu_rating_count = pdu_judgeme_widget_markup | split: "data-reviews-count='" | last | split: "'" | first | replace: ',', '' | plus: 0 endif endif endif assign photo_strip_heading = customer_photos_heading if pdu_rating_count > 0 assign photo_strip_heading = photo_heading endif assign matching_set_builder_copy = matching_set_copy assign matching_set_guide_enabled = false assign matching_set_guide_label_1 = 'Top and pants are separate pieces' assign matching_set_guide_label_2 = 'Add mom and child sizes together' assign matching_set_guide_label_3 = 'Tap a size to see measurements' if product.handle == 'golden-daisy-mommy-and-me-set' and current_locale_root == 'en' assign matching_set_guide_enabled = true assign matching_set_builder_copy = 'Pair the yellow daisy top with the ivory floral pants for a complete mommy-and-me outfit.' endif -%}
{%- comment -%} CRO redesign (May 2026): stacked family-member cards with pills + quantity steppers + live bundle summary. The summary panel sits ABOVE the CTA so the count, total, and current cart subtotal are visible before commitment. The CTA below is the single primary action — the standalone Add-to-Cart is hidden via CSS on matching-set products (see component-product-desktop-ux.css). The static trust row under the CTA mirrors the spec — compact reassurance directly adjacent to the buy moment, not below fold. {%- endcomment -%}
